clips.title: Both wait
clips.caption: Two Foxes 12.59 units apart, blue with his back 12 units from the ledge. The tick under the stage is how far red's shine reaches a standing Fox: blue is outside it. Searched 8 frames deep, red's chance of a clean first hit is 0, and the best play for both is this: nothing.
notes: Both wait. Whatever either starts, the other sees one frame later.

clips.title: Same-frame shines
clips.caption: Up close (7.19 units) both press shine on the same frame. The two hitboxes clank: both freeze for 4 frames and nobody takes damage.
notes: Standing in each other's shine range.
Frame 1: both shine. The hitboxes meet.
Clank: 4 frames of freeze, 0% to both.
Both are left holding the reflector. Nothing happened.

clips.title: One frame earlier
clips.caption: Same spot, but red presses one frame before blue. The shine hits on the frame it is pressed, so blue's shine never comes out: 5%.
notes: Standing in each other's shine range.
Frame 1: red shines. It hits at once: 5%.
Frame 2: blue presses shine too, but he is already hit.

clips.title: Standing, 12.6 away
clips.caption: Red shines at a standing Fox from 12.59 units. It comes out on frame 1 and touches nothing.
notes: 12.59 apart: outside shine range.
Frame 1: shine. No hit.
Red is now stuck in the shine for a few frames.

clips.title: Standing, 10.2 away
clips.caption: One step closer, at 10.19 units, the same shine hits for 5%. From 10.79 it still misses: the reach against a standing Fox is about 10.7.
notes: 10.19 apart: inside shine range.
Frame 1: shine. 5%.

clips.title: Jumpsquat, 12.6 away
clips.caption: Back at 12.59. Blue presses jump; for 3 frames he crouches on the ground before leaving it (the jumpsquat). In that crouch the shine reaches him.
notes: 12.59 apart again.
Frame 1: blue starts a jump (jumpsquat).
Frame 2: red shines. It reaches: 5%.

clips.title: Roll start, 12.6 away
clips.caption: Blue rolls away out of shield from 12.59. In the first frames of the roll the shine reaches him too, before he has moved or become intangible.
notes: Blue in shield, 12.59 away.
Frame 1: blue starts rolling away.
Frame 2: red shines. It reaches: 5%.

clips.title: Let go
clips.caption: Blue lets go of the shield. Dropping it takes several frames in which he can do nothing. Red sees it on frame 2, turns around (that is how the search makes the shine reach from here) and shines on frame 3: 5%.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue lets go of the shield.
Frame 2: red has seen it, and turns around.
Frame 3: red shines. 5%.

clips.title: Jump
clips.caption: Blue jumps out of shield. A jump starts with 3 frames of crouch on the ground (the jumpsquat). Red sees it and shines on frame 2, and the shine reaches that crouch even from 14.39: 5% before blue leaves the floor.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue jumps out of shield (jumpsquat).
Frame 2: red has seen it, and shines. 5%.

clips.title: Roll in
clips.caption: Blue rolls toward red. The shine would miss this one, so red jabs instead: the jab comes out a frame later and catches the start of the roll. 4%.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue starts rolling in.
Frame 2: red has seen it, and jabs.
Frame 3: the jab lands. 4%.

clips.title: Roll away
clips.caption: Blue rolls toward the ledge. The roll takes time to get going. Red turns around and shines its first frames from where he stands: 5%.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue starts rolling away.
Frame 2: red has seen it, and turns around.
Frame 3: red shines. 5%.

clips.title: Shield grab
clips.caption: Blue grabs out of shield. The grab cannot reach 14.39 units. Red waits while it comes out and shines on frame 7, the frame the search finds: 5%.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue grabs out of shield.
Red waits: the grab cannot reach him.
Frame 7: red shines the outstretched arm. 5%.

clips.title: Spotdodge
clips.caption: Blue sidesteps on the spot (a spotdodge) and cannot be hit for most of it. Red does not chase: he starts an up smash on frame 9 so that it lands on frame 17, as the dodge wears off. 18%, the most expensive exit.
notes: Blue holds shield, 14.39 away. Red waits.
Frame 1: blue spotdodges.
Blue cannot be hit (dashed outline). Red has seen it and counts.
Frame 9: red starts an up smash.
Frame 17: the dodge has worn off and the up smash is there. 18%.

clips.title: Blue waits
clips.caption: Red shines on the first frame. Blue did nothing, and the shine is already there: 5%.
notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 5 frames into the hop, 9.42 away and 4.0 up.
Frame 1: red shines. 5%.

clips.title: Blue steps away

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 5 frames into the hop, 9.42 away and 4.0 up.
Frame 1: red shines as blue turns to run. 5%.

clips.title: Blue jabs

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 5 frames into the hop, 9.42 away and 4.0 up.

clips.title: Blue jumps

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 5 frames into the hop, 9.42 away and 4.0 up.
Frame 1: red shines blue's jumpsquat. 5%.

clips.title: Blue shines too
clips.caption: The one answer that survives the first frame: blue shines as well, and neither can be hit. But red is in the air, so he can jump out of his shine with his second jump and shine again from higher up. Blue, on the ground, is still holding his: 5% on frame 10.
notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 5 frames into the hop, 9.42 away and 4.0 up.
Frame 1: both shine. Neither can be hit on that frame.
Both hold the reflector.
Frame 9: red jumps out of his shine.
Frame 10: red shines again. 5%.

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 9 frames into the hop, 7.8 away and 9.2 up. Both now choose at once.
Frame 1: red waits. Blue turns to run.
Blue dashes away, out of reach.
Frame 8: the search ends here, blue on the edge of the stage. Nobody hit.

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 9 frames into the hop, 7.8 away and 9.2 up. Both now choose at once.
Frame 1: blue shines. It cannot reach red. Red just waited.
Frame 2: red shines from above. 5%.

notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.

clips.title: Both shine
clips.caption: Both shine on the same frame. Each is intangible (cannot be hit) on the first frame of his shine, so neither is hit, and blue is safe for the 8 frames searched.
notes: Red short-hops at the cornered blue.
Red is 9 frames into the hop, 7.8 away and 9.2 up. Both now choose at once.

Both hold the reflector. Red drifts down.

clips.title: The walk in
clips.caption: The match starts with the two Foxes 120 units apart. Red walks, never dashes, for 182 frames (3 seconds), and blue stands and watches. On frame 183 red flicks his stick away. That is the whole line.
notes: Match start: both at their spawns, 120 apart.
Red walks in. Blue waits.
Still far apart: nothing either does can reach yet.
Inside 17 units. Blue's list of safe inputs is getting shorter.
Frame 182: 13.71 apart. Stepping away is blue's last safe input here.
Frame 183: red flicks the stick away. 13.19 apart, and blue has no safe input left.

clips.title: Both wait
clips.caption: Nothing happens on this frame, but blue is not out of it. Red's turn slides him closer, and one frame later blue faces another guess: red's chance over the remaining 7 frames is 0.5. The clip stops there.
notes: Red walks in. Blue waits.
Frame 183: red flicks the stick away. 13.19 apart.
Frame 184: both choose at once.
Frame 185: 12.39 apart. Blue has to guess again.
The clip ends here: the position is still a guess, not a safe one.

clips.title: Red waits, blue steps away

notes: Red walks in. Blue waits.

Frame 184: both choose at once.
Frame 185: blue jabs, the input the search proves safe.
Frame 191: the search ends here. Nobody hit.

Frame 183: red flicks the stick away. 13.19 apart.
Frame 184: blue shines. It reaches red in his turn: 5% to red.

clips.title: Giving ground
clips.caption: The same walk, but blue does not wait for the flick. At 13.71 apart he dashes back: two frames of stick, and the dash carries him 21.62 units. He is out of danger, and 3.95 units from the ledge.
notes: Red walks in. Blue waits.
Frame 182: 13.71 apart, the last safe moment.
Frame 183: blue dashes back.
Red keeps walking. Blue cannot be reached.
Blue stops 3.95 from the ledge. He has spent 21.62 units of stage.
Red is still walking in. There is no room for a second dash like that.

clips.title: Red shields, blue shines
clips.caption: Blue's shine lands on red's shield. Hitting a shield pushes the attacker back, and blue has no stage behind him: on frame 5 he slides off the ledge, still stuck in his shine. Our rules count leaving the stage as a loss; what happens after that was not played out.
notes: Blue stands on the ledge. Red is 8.52 away. Both choose at once.
Frame 1: blue shines into red's shield. Both freeze for 4 frames.
Frame 5: the pushback slides blue off the stage. Counted as red's point.
Blue starts to fall, still holding his shine.
